# Nolly Dey

## Summary

A quiet watchman killed when a wretch emerged through the bunk wall behind him.

## Appearance

Thin, dark-haired, with an oversized watch coat and a carved bird whistle.

## Voice

Soft and methodical.

## Goals

Complete enough service to join the river patrol.

## Private pressure

His last words are repeated by one of the wretches in Kellan's memory.

## Author notes

Retired historical character.
